title: codeaster-en command catalog extract (en/commands/<COMMAND>.json)
description: One code_aster command as defined in the pinned upstream catalog (code_aster/Cata/Commands/), written by `caen extract catalog` (task 1.2). Generated: never hand-edit; change the extractor (tools/codeaster_en/extract/catalog.py) instead. Values are copied from the catalog definition without interpretation. Where an optional field is absent, the catalog did not set the argument; the defaults the syntax checker then applies are given in each field's description, citing upstream code_aster/Cata/Language/.

file.description: Catalog module that defines the command, relative to upstream/.

command.description: Command name exactly as in the catalog (French; never renamed).

kind.description: Catalog constructor: OPER (operator, op= is a Fortran operator number), MACRO (Python macro-command), PROC (procedure, no result), FORM (FORMULE).

fr.description: French help string of the command (fr=), or null when the catalog has none.

translation_upstream.description: Upstream's own English labels (translation= argument, used by AsterStudy): {French name: English label}. Null when absent. Data only: the glossary (en/glossary.yaml) decides our English.

op.description: op= argument: Fortran operator number for OPER/PROC, Python callable path for MACRO, or null.

reentrant.description: reentrant= argument verbatim: 'n' (no), 'o:<KW>' (mandatory), 'f:<KW>' (optional, result can be reused through keyword <KW>). Null when absent.

result_types.description: Concept types the command can produce (sd_prod=). Empty for commands without a result. When sd_prod is a function, this is upstream's Command.get_all_types() list; null if that call fails.

result_type_depends_on_keywords.description: True when sd_prod= is a function of the keywords given.

has_compat_syntax.description: True when the catalog defines compat_syntax= (a converter for deprecated syntax).

docu.description: docu= argument verbatim (documentation reference) when present.

source.description: Where the object is constructed in upstream: file relative to upstream/ and the line of the OPER/MACRO/PROC/SIMP/FACT/BLOC call. Shared keywords (code_aster/Cata/Commons/) point to the Commons file.

path.description: Keyword path as the user writes it: factor keywords add a segment (AFFE/GROUP_MA); blocs do not, because their keywords are written at the bloc's parent level. A bloc's own path ends with its name in brackets (SOLVEUR/[b_mumps]).

status.description: statut= argument: 'o' mandatory, 'f' optional, 'c' hidden (filled by the supervisor), 'd' factor keyword present by default. Absent statut is 'f' (SyntaxObjects.PartOfSyntax._def_status).

value.description: A catalog value. Complex numbers are {"complex": [re, im]}; non-finite floats are {"float": repr}; class objects are their class name.

cardinality.description: min=/max= as written. max '**' means unbounded. Absent max means 1 (SyntaxChecker: definition.get('max', 1)). Absent min means no lower bound on the number of values of a simple keyword and 0 occurrences of a factor keyword (SyntaxChecker: definition.get('min') / definition.get('min', 0)).

rules.description: Catalog rules (regles=), by their catalog name.

defaults.description: Default values inserted by AU_MOINS_UN/UN_PARMI when none of the keywords is given.

validators.description: validators= argument: validator class name (code_aster/Cata/Language/Validators.py) and its arguments.

other.description: Definition arguments this extractor does not interpret, copied verbatim (e.g. a misspelt 'default=' that the syntax checker ignores). Present only when non-empty.

entities.description: Keywords and blocs in catalog order.

type.description: typ= as a list: 'R' real, 'I' integer, 'C' complex, 'TXM' text, or a concept/unit class name (maillage_sdaster, grma, UnitDefault, ...). Several entries mean any of them is accepted.

default.description: defaut= argument. Absent when the catalog gives no default.

enum.description: enum= argument verbatim (integer codes parallel to into=).

inout.description: inout= argument verbatim ('in'/'out', for file units).

factor.description: Factor keyword (FACT): a group of keywords, possibly repeated (max > 1).

bloc.description: Conditional bloc (BLOC): its keywords are allowed only when the condition holds. The condition is a Python expression evaluated by upstream (SyntaxObjects.Bloc.isEnabled) against the keywords already given.
